The more qualified candidates on the platform, the more roles we can fill. You will help us build channels and funnels to bring the best engineering talent to our platform and match them with life-changing career opportunities.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>You have one job: grow the number of qualified and relevant candidates entering the platform.</p> <p>There is no second metric. You work directly with the founder.</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Most content gets made and then dies at a few hundred views, because getting it out is still done by hand: a person, a phone, a few accounts. We want it engineered: iPhone and Android device automation at scale, platform APIs and agents posting across many accounts and surfaces, every link tracked. If you would rather build that fleet than tap through posts one at a time, read on.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Vertex Marketing Group builds AI creators and makes the content for real ones. Your job is to get that content out at a volume no team could post by hand, and keep the machine running. Based in Europe or Latin America</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Big plus:</strong> a development, infrastructure or DevOps background, and growth analytics: you read the numbers and know what to post more of.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>$4,000 to $6,000 per month, full-time, remote. Where you land in the range depends on what you show us. Same rate from day one of the paid test. Reviewed after 6 months.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Why Vertex?</strong></p> <p>• You own the outcome: your fleet, your numbers, your call on what goes out where</p> <p>• You work directly with the founder, in a small team of sharp people who are fun to work with</p> <p>• Content to distribute every day, and the budget for the devices and the stack</p> <p>• The mission: become one of the best in the world at this, fast, then package what we build for other agencies</p> <p>• Fast decisions.
